notes.freshness: Status is recomputed against the current time; ≠ marks a mismatch with the status stored at write time.
notes.quarantine: Accept/reject only changes the item's status and never writes the target table; if someone else already resolved it, you'll be told and the list refreshes.
notes.calendar: Overdue counts only rows with a known statutory deadline and an actual period end; estimated (52/53-week) and no-rule rows never count, nor does an unknown upstream.
notes.claims: Accepting writes the target row in the same transaction; evidence_only claims need the amendment form first; legacy claims are handled with SQL per the runbook.

calendar.counts: overdue {overdue} · filed not ingested {filed} · upstream unknown {unknown} · estimated {estimated} · no rule {noRule}
calendar.legend: Statutory / estimated / no rule · overdue red, filed-not-ingested amber, upstream unknown grey italic
calendar.estimatedHint: Estimated period end of a 52/53-week filer; replaced by the actual end once the filing arrives

amend.noSecurities: This issuer has no security rows to amend

quarantine.noRowsPromoted: The item was closed, but no fact was restored (still referenced by another disputed item).

restore.passing: The latest reconciliation passed; if inputs changed since, the server refuses and asks for a re-run.
restore.not_passing: The latest reconciliation did not pass; fix and re-run it first.
restore.no_result: No reconciliation result yet; re-run it first.
restore.inputs_changed: Inputs changed after the latest passing reconciliation; re-run it first.
restore.unchecked: Not checked (over the per-load check limit; narrow the filter and reload)

conflicts.already_resolved: This item was already handled; the list has been refreshed.
conflicts.item_not_open: This item was already handled; the list has been refreshed.
conflicts.legacy_claim: Legacy claims cannot be handled here; use SQL per the runbook.
conflicts.amend_required: An evidence_only claim needs an amendment before it can be accepted.
conflicts.value_conflict: The target value changed or conflicts; the claim stays pending.
conflicts.ownership_conflict: Security ownership conflict; the claim stays pending.
conflicts.already_closed: The target security row is already closed.
conflicts.not_passing: The latest reconciliation did not pass or its inputs changed; re-run it first.
conflicts.reconcile_wiring_missing: The server has no reconciliation input hash wired yet; restore is unavailable.
conflicts.inputs_unavailable: The current reconciliation inputs are unavailable (no latest result or the left fact is missing); re-run it first.
conflicts.current_evidence_unavailable: The pair's current right-side evidence (document or manifest entry) cannot be obtained right now; restore is unavailable.
conflicts.read_truncated: The read was truncated, so nothing was evaluated; try again later.
conflicts.stale_evaluation: The data just changed; refresh and try again.
conflicts.generation_moved: The mapping generation changed; refresh and try again.
conflicts.conflict_exists: A disputed or different current value exists for this key and date; adoption refused.
conflicts.duplicate: This candidate already exists; nothing to adopt.
conflicts.replay_required: The original snapshot must be replayed before this candidate can be adopted.
conflicts.filing_not_found: The filing the candidate points to was not found.
conflicts.lineage_changed: The lineage changed; refresh and try again.
conflicts.scope_missing: A lineage member has no sync scope row; contact an administrator.
conflicts.unresolved: More than one current value would remain; rolled back.
conflicts.run_pending: The related sync run has not finished; try again later.
conflicts.issuer_not_active: The issuer is not currently active; the claim stays pending.
